newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss retail sales down 1.8 percent in December.
newsitem.headline: Swiss retail sales down 1.8 percent in December.

text.p: Swiss retail sales, measured by value, fell 1.8 percent in December compared with a 0.8 percent drop in November, and a drop of 5.9 percent in December 1995, the Federal Statistics Office said.

"The major loss of consumers' desire for purchases seen for some time continued in December, and the Christmas business from the point of view of the retail industry tended to be sobering," the Statistics Office said.
Adjusted for inflation, real retail turnover was 2.5 percent lower in December versus December 1995.
Food and luxury items fell by 2.5 percent, apparel and textiles were down 5.9 percent and the decline in other branches was 1.1 percent.
